subtitles.en:
Hello everyone! Welcome once more to AB Slow
Spanish Cafe.
subtitles.zh:
大家好！歡迎再次來到 AB Slow
Spanish Cafe。

subtitles.en:
Hello, Alex! And hello to all our listeners
at home.
subtitles.zh: 你好，Alex！也向我們所有在家收聽的聽眾問好。

subtitles.en:
Today we are going to talk about a topic that
is hard for many of us: exercise, health, and
the gym.
subtitles.zh: 今天我們要談論一個對我們許多人來說都很困難的話題：運動、健康和健身房。

subtitles.en:
Phew, the gym! Many people don't like paying
the monthly fee if they almost never go.
subtitles.zh: 唉，健身房！很多人不喜歡付月費，如果他們幾乎不去的話。

subtitles.en:
Exactly. That's why today we will talk about
a new global trend: simple exercise at home.
Prepare your coffee and listen to us calmly.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯。這就是為什麼今天我們要談談一個新的全球趨勢：在家簡單運動。準備好你的咖啡，冷靜地聽我們說。

subtitles.en:
The sentences are short and very easy. Turn
on subtitles in your language, and let's get
started.
subtitles.zh: 句子很短且非常簡單。打開你語言的字幕，讓我們開始吧。

subtitles.en:
Mia, last week I tried to go to the gym after
a long time. And the truth is... I felt very
tired just by looking at the heavy machines.
subtitles.zh: Mia，上週我試著在很久之後去健身房。老實說……光是看著那些沉重的器材，我就覺得很累了。

subtitles.en:
I understand you perfectly, Alex. Many people
think that to be in shape you need to spend
two hours at the gym lifting giant weights.
subtitles.zh: 我完全理解你，Alex。很多人認為要保持身材，就需要花兩個小時在健身房舉重。

subtitles.en:
Yes! And that scares beginners. You pay the
month's money, you go three times, your whole
body hurts, and you quit.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！那會嚇跑初學者。你付了月費，去了三次，全身痠痛，然後就放棄了。

subtitles.en:
That's why now there is a very big change in
people's mindset. It's called "minimalist
fitness" or smart exercise.
subtitles.zh: 這就是為什麼現在人們的心態有了很大的轉變。這被稱為「極簡健身」或聰明運動。

subtitles.en:
What does that mean exactly, Mia? Does it
mean doing nothing?
subtitles.zh: 那具體是什麼意思呢，Mia？是指什麼都不做嗎？

subtitles.en:
On the contrary. It means spending less time,
but with more consistency. For example,
"micro-workouts" of ten or fifteen minutes a
day.
subtitles.zh: 恰恰相反。這意味著花更少的時間，但更持之以恆。例如，每天十到十五分鐘的「微運動」。

subtitles.en:
Ten minutes? That sounds very easy. Do ten
minutes a day really do anything?
subtitles.zh: 十分鐘？聽起來很容易。每天十分鐘真的有效嗎？

subtitles.en:
Of course! Doctors and trainers say that ten
minutes of daily movement are much better
than zero minutes on the couch.
subtitles.zh: 當然！醫生和教練都說，每天十分鐘的活動遠比在沙發上零分鐘要好得多。

subtitles.en:
That is a great truth. Many times we say: "I
don't have a free hour to go to the gym." But
ten minutes... everyone has ten free minutes.
subtitles.zh: 這是一個偉大的真理。我們常說：「我沒有空出一小時去健身房。」但十分鐘……每個人都有十分鐘的空檔。

subtitles.en:
Exactly. You can do push-ups, squats, or
stretches in your living room while watching
the news or listening to our podcast.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯。你可以在客廳看新聞或聽我們的播客時，做伏地挺身、深蹲或伸展運動。

subtitles.en:
Besides, walking fast through the park also
counts as exercise, right?
subtitles.zh: 此外，在公園快走也算運動，對吧？

subtitles.en:
Of course! Walking is one of the best
exercises in the world for the heart and for
the mind. It doesn't cost money and you can
do it anywhere.
subtitles.zh: 當然！走路是世界上對心臟和心靈最好的運動之一。它不需要花錢，而且你可以在任何地方做。

subtitles.en:
I like this idea a lot. I don't need to
suffer on difficult machines to take care of
my body.
subtitles.zh: 我很喜歡這個主意。我不需要為了照顧身體而在困難的器材上受苦。

subtitles.en:
Health is not a competition. The important
thing is to create a daily habit that you can
maintain for years, not just one week.
subtitles.zh: 健康不是一場比賽。重要的是養成一個你可以堅持多年的日常習慣，而不僅僅是一週。

subtitles.en:
I'm taking notes, Mia. Today I am going to
start with ten minutes of stretching at home.
subtitles.zh: 我記下來了，Mia。今天我要從在家伸展十分鐘開始。

subtitles.en:
Excellent decision, Alex. Now we are going to
review five very useful words about the body
and healthy lifestyle. Listen and repeat
after us.
subtitles.zh: 很棒的決定，Alex。現在我們要複習五個關於身體和健康生活方式的實用詞彙。請聽並跟著我們重複。

subtitles.en: Phrase one: To exercise.
subtitles.zh: 第一句：運動。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Hacer ejercicio.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Hacer ejercicio。

subtitles.en: Phrase two: To be in shape.
subtitles.zh: 第二句：保持身材。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Estar en forma.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Estar en forma。

subtitles.en: Phrase three: Stretching.
subtitles.zh: 第三句：伸展。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Estiramientos.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Estiramientos。

subtitles.en: Phrase four: Mental and physical health.
subtitles.zh: 第四句：身心健康。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Salud mental y física.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Salud mental y física。

subtitles.en: Phrase five: To build a habit.
subtitles.zh: 第五句：養成習慣。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Crear un hábito.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們重複：Crear un hábito。

subtitles.en: Great job with the phrases!
subtitles.zh: 這些短句表現得很好！

subtitles.en:
Now, listen to the main conversation again
without looking at the text. Accept the
challenge!
subtitles.zh: 現在，再聽一次主要對話，不要看文字。接受挑戰吧！

subtitles.en:
And you, do you prefer going to the gym or
exercising at home calmly?
subtitles.zh: 那麼你呢，你比較喜歡去健身房，還是冷靜地在家運動？

subtitles.en:
Leave us your comment below in Spanish or in
your language. We want to read your daily
habits.
subtitles.zh: 在下方留言告訴我們，可以用西班牙語或你的母語。我們很想讀讀你的日常習慣。

subtitles.en:
If you want to practice your pronunciation,
use our free tools, L-Player and AI Speaking
Tutor, in the description of the video.
subtitles.zh: 如果你想練習發音，請使用我們影片說明中的免費工具：L-Player 和 AI Speaking Tutor。

subtitles.en:
Subscribe to AB Slow Spanish Cafe for more
slow and simple conversations! See you next
time!
subtitles.zh: 訂閱 AB Slow Spanish Cafe 以獲取更多緩慢且簡單的對話！下次見！
